fixture.source: deterministic host fixture with valid Mode1 FAD/EDC

limitations: Synthetic sectors and authored optical scheduling; no Dreamcast hardware, real GD-ROM firmware timing, damaged-media behavior or Shenmue II retail sectors execute.
The fixture reproduces142 remaining sectors relative to the leadout; it does not reproduce the physical FAD549158 timeout itself.
Single-sector PIO is a conservative bounded mitigation, not proof of the original DMA/PIO timeout cause or proof that the real disc now completes.
